name: Lady Jeisa
source:
Lady Jeisa of Laskari is new to the capital and the first of your ladies-in-waiting. 
Her brearing is unflappable and composed at all times... unless a handsome guard happens to be making eyes at her.

She has her own opinions on how you do things, but will mostly keep them to herself.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/490618601/queens-crown]Kickstarter[/url]]
